content.text:
Implemented the Linux-only conditional accessible “jump to now-playing track” action in **`lib/screens/void_screen.dart`**:

- The ⊙ glyph (key: `void-crumb-jump-to-playing`) is now **only shown when a track is playing** (`playingExists`).
- On **Linux**, it is shown **even when the playing track’s parent is already the current browser folder** (so the action is available to bring an off-screen row into view).
- Tapping it keeps the browser in the same folder (it only loads the parent if needed) and uses `browserController.scrollToTrack(playingPath)` to make the row visible.

### Before / After screenshots (Linux, playing track off-screen → activation scrolls it into view)

**Before activation** (track not visible in the browser viewport):
- `./.tmp/agent_shots/before_track_54.png`

**After activation** (track row is centered/visible; browser folder unchanged):
- `./.tmp/agent_shots/after_track_54_delayed.png`
